clauses.quote: However, absent the presence of a dangerous weapon or drugs, in no case may a special education student be excluded from school in excess of ten days without the IEP Committee convening to address the behavioral issue.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit actor is district administration. Grants students a right to not be excluded >10 days without IEP review. Benefits students but mapped to worker per binary constraint.

clauses.quote: Any changes in the student's educational program or changes in placement must be decided by the IEP Committee.
clauses.subject_text: Any changes in the student's educational program or changes in placement
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit actor is IEP Committee (district body). Imposes obligation to require committee approval for program/placement changes.
